subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: What canonical gateway-backed activity and attention contract should the Control UI use for compact active-run progress?
rationale: The remaining work changes public session-state semantics and Control UI UX; open candidates overlap but do not settle the full phase, attention, stale-run, child-rollup, and reconnect model.

options.title: Define the canonical activity contract
options.body: Approve the sessions.activity/RPC/event or equivalent schema first, then align the Control UI strip and open PRs to it.

options.title: Ship a narrower UI slice
options.body: Accept a smaller Control UI progress strip using only currently supported signals while keeping broader attention and stale-run work tracked separately.

options.title: Defer until PRs converge
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause new work until the existing activity PRs resolve conflicts, proof, and API-scope concerns.

recommendation.title: Define the canonical activity contract
recommendation.body: Approve the sessions.activity/RPC/event or equivalent schema first, then align the Control UI strip and open PRs to it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the canonical related activity-contract issue and has recent gateway/protocol-adjacent history.
